name: URINE PREGNANCY TEST
description: Urine Pregnancy Test detects human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine to confirm pregnancy. This immunochromatographic assay provides rapid qualitative results.
literatureReview: Urine Pregnancy Test detects hCG produced by syncytiotrophoblast cells. Normal: negative. Positive: pregnancy confirmed. hCG detectable 8-10 days post-conception, peaks at 8-10 weeks. Sensitivity: 25 mIU/mL. Immunochromatographic assay uses monoclonal antibodies against hCG beta subunit. Qualitative result: positive/negative. False positives rare. False negatives with very early pregnancy or dilute urine. Confirm positive results with serum hCG. Used for pregnancy diagnosis, ectopic pregnancy screening, and gestational trophoblastic disease monitoring. Critical for reproductive health assessment.
